_comment: Tracked example UI journeys for the mock app. The desktop host reads this as a seed for the Stories panel, so these survive a `git clean` of the gitignored .brainrouter/ dir. Targets must exist in the mock's ui-map (see src/pages.ts).

stories.title: Log in
stories.description: Open Login, enter valid credentials, submit, and confirm the message.

stories.title: Add a todo
stories.description: Go to Todos, type a new item, add it, and confirm the count updates.

stories.title: Count up
stories.description: On Home, increment the counter twice and confirm the value stays visible.
